question: Prepare a comprehensive performance report on our sellers, focusing on total sales, average item price, average review scores, and packing times. Ensure that the report includes only those sellers who have sold a quantity of more than 100 products and highlight the product category names in English with the highest sales volume.
sql:
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price,
        COUNT(*) as item_count
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(r.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - TRY_CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP)
        )) / 86400) as avg_packing_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_top_category AS (
    WITH seller_category_sales AS (
        SELECT 
            oi.seller_id,
            pcat.product_category_name_english,
            SUM(oi.price) as category_sales,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rn
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
        GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
    )
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        product_category_name_english as top_category_english
    FROM seller_category_sales
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_sales,
    ROUND(sm.avg_item_price, 2) as avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sr.avg_review_score, 2) as avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sp.avg_packing_days, 2) as avg_packing_days,
    stc.top_category_english
FROM seller_metrics sm
JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
JOIN seller_top_category stc ON sm.seller_id = stc.seller_id
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC
